<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1800 600" width="1800" height="600"
  font-family="'Courier New', monospace">

  <defs>
    <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         GRADIENTS & FILTERS
    ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
    <linearGradient id="bg_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#0d1117"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#161b22"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="panel_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1f2937"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#111827"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="roll_grad_top" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#6b7280"/>
      <stop offset="40%"  stop-color="#d1d5db"/>
      <stop offset="60%"  stop-color="#9ca3af"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4b5563"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="roll_grad_bot" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#4b5563"/>
      <stop offset="40%"  stop-color="#9ca3af"/>
      <stop offset="60%"  stop-color="#d1d5db"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#6b7280"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="reel_grad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%" fx="35%" fy="35%" gradientUnits="objectBoundingBox" id="reel_grad_r" gradientTransform="rotate(0)">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#374151"/>
      <stop offset="60%"  stop-color="#1f2937"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#111827"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <radialGradient id="reel_grad_r" cx="40%" cy="35%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#6b7280"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1f2937"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="hpu_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="0%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#1e3a5f"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1e40af"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="frame_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#374151"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1f2937"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="web_grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="0%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%"   stop-color="#92400e" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="50%"  stop-color="#b45309"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#78350f" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
    </linearGradient>

    <filter id="glow_green" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="3" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="glow_blue" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%">
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="blur"/>
      <feMerge><feMergeNode in="blur"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge>
    </filter>
    <filter id="drop_shadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="2" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.6"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="panel_shadow">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="6" flood-color="#000" flood-opacity="0.8"/>
    </filter>

    <!-- Web (electrode foil) moving animation -->
    <pattern id="web_pattern" x="0" y="0" width="40" height="1" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect width="40" height="1" fill="#b45309"/>
      <rect x="0" width="38" height="1" fill="#d97706" opacity="0.4"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="patternTransform" type="translate" from="0,0" to="-40,0" dur="1.2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </pattern>

    <!-- Roll rotation markers -->
    <marker id="tick" markerWidth="4" markerHeight="4" refX="2" refY="2">
      <circle cx="2" cy="2" r="1.5" fill="#374151"/>
    </marker>

    <!-- Clip paths -->
    <clipPath id="clip_roll_top">
      <rect x="830" y="238" width="140" height="54" rx="4"/>
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id="clip_roll_bot">
      <rect x="830" y="308" width="140" height="54" rx="4"/>
    </clipPath>

    <!-- Status LED pulse animation -->
    <animate id="pulse_run" attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.3;1" dur="1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </defs>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 0 — BACKGROUND & FLOOR
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <rect id="bg" width="1800" height="600" fill="url(#bg_grad)"/>
  <!-- Floor line -->
  <rect x="0" y="530" width="1800" height="70" fill="#0a0e13" opacity="0.7"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="530" x2="1800" y2="530" stroke="#1f2937" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Grid lines subtle -->
  <g id="grp_grid" opacity="0.04" stroke="#94a3b8" stroke-width="0.5">
    <line x1="0" y1="100" x2="1800" y2="100"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="200" x2="1800" y2="200"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="300" x2="1800" y2="300"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="400" x2="1800" y2="400"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="500" x2="1800" y2="500"/>
    <line x1="200" y1="0" x2="200" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="400" y1="0" x2="400" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="600" y1="0" x2="600" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="800" y1="0" x2="800" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="1000" y1="0" x2="1000" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="1200" y1="0" x2="1200" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="1400" y1="0" x2="1400" y2="600"/>
    <line x1="1600" y1="0" x2="1600" y2="600"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 1 — MACHINE TITLE BAR
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_title_bar">
    <rect x="10" y="8" width="1780" height="36" rx="4" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="24" y="31" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="3">PNT ROLL-TO-ROLL CALENDERING MACHINE</text>
    <text x="24" y="31" dx="430" fill="#64748b" font-size="11" letter-spacing="1"> │  ANODE / CATHODE ELECTRODE PRESSING LINE</text>
    <!-- Live clock placeholder -->
    <rect x="1540" y="14" width="240" height="22" rx="3" fill="#0d1117" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text id="txt_timestamp" x="1552" y="29" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" letter-spacing="1">STATION: CAL-LINE-01  │  READY</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 2 — ELECTRODE WEB (foil path)
       id: grp_web — bind color/opacity to running status
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_web">
    <!-- Entry web: unwinder → EPC → dancer → NIP -->
    <rect id="web_seg_entry" x="155" y="296" width="255" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- EPC deflect angle -->
    <rect id="web_seg_epc" x="405" y="296" width="80" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- Dancer loop (simplified straight) -->
    <rect id="web_seg_dancer_in" x="480" y="296" width="100" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- Entry tension → NIP -->
    <rect id="web_seg_pre_nip" x="575" y="296" width="260" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- Through NIP (calender rolls — thinner post-press) -->
    <rect id="web_seg_nip" x="830" y="296" width="140" height="8" fill="#92400e" opacity="0.95"/>
    <!-- Exit tension -->
    <rect id="web_seg_post_nip" x="965" y="296" width="205" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- Gauge pass-through -->
    <rect id="web_seg_gauge" x="1165" y="296" width="100" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- Exit EPC → rewinder -->
    <rect id="web_seg_exit" x="1260" y="296" width="380" height="8" fill="url(#web_grad)"/>
    <!-- Moving sheen overlay -->
    <rect x="155" y="296" width="1485" height="8" fill="url(#web_pattern)" opacity="0.5"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 3 — UNWINDER (PAY-OFF REEL)
       id: grp_unwinder
       Bindings: reel_diameter, unwind_tension, reel_speed_rpm
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_unwinder" filter="url(#drop_shadow)">
    <!-- Base frame -->
    <rect x="30" y="380" width="160" height="150" rx="4" fill="url(#frame_grad)" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="38" y="388" width="144" height="10" rx="2" fill="#111827"/>
    <!-- Reel core + flange -->
    <circle id="reel_unwind_outer" cx="110" cy="300" r="85" fill="url(#reel_grad_r)" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Reel rotation spokes -->
    <g id="reel_unwind_spokes" transform-origin="110 300">
      <line x1="110" y1="225" x2="110" y2="375" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="35"  y1="300" x2="185" y2="300" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="3"/>
      <line x1="57"  y1="247" x2="163" y2="353" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="163" y1="247" x2="57"  y2="353" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 110 300" to="360 110 300" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Core hub -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="300" r="22" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="110" cy="300" r="10" fill="#374151" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Shaft -->
    <rect x="190" y="294" width="30" height="12" rx="3" fill="#4b5563" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Flange guides -->
    <rect x="25"  y="260" width="8" height="80" rx="2" fill="#374151" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="182" y="260" width="8" height="80" rx="2" fill="#374151" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="1"/>
    <!-- Label -->
    <rect x="48" y="430" width="124" height="48" rx="3" fill="#0d1117" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="110" y="446" fill="#94a3b8" font-size="8.5" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="1">UNWINDER</text>
    <text id="txt_unwind_dia" x="110" y="459" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">Ø 850 mm</text>
    <text id="txt_unwind_tension" x="110" y="471" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">T: 35.2 N</text>
    <!-- Status LED -->
    <circle id="led_unwinder" cx="155" cy="392" r="5" fill="#22c55e" filter="url(#glow_green)">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 4 — EPC ENTRY (Edge Position Control)
       id: grp_epc_entry
       Bindings: epc_position_mm, epc_mode, epc_alarm
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_epc_entry" filter="url(#drop_shadow)">
    <!-- Frame -->
    <rect x="220" y="230" width="60" height="180" rx="4" fill="url(#panel_grad)" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Actuator cylinder -->
    <rect x="236" y="248" width="28" height="70" rx="3" fill="#1e3a5f" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="243" y="256" width="14" height="10" rx="2" fill="#3b82f6" opacity="0.7"/>
    <!-- EPC sensor bar -->
    <rect x="228" y="326" width="44" height="12" rx="2" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="250" y="336" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="7" text-anchor="middle">EPC</text>
    <!-- Position indicator -->
    <rect x="228" y="344" width="44" height="28" rx="2" fill="#0a0e13" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="250" y="355" fill="#64748b" font-size="7" text-anchor="middle">POS</text>
    <text id="txt_epc_entry_pos" x="250" y="367" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">+0.2mm</text>
    <!-- CCD sensor symbol -->
    <rect x="228" y="378" width="44" height="18" rx="2" fill="#172554" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="250" y="391" fill="#93c5fd" font-size="7.5" text-anchor="middle">CCD ●</text>
    <!-- Status LED -->
    <circle id="led_epc_entry" cx="264" cy="238" r="4.5" fill="#22c55e" filter="url(#glow_green)">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <text x="250" y="420" fill="#475569" font-size="7.5" text-anchor="middle">EPC-IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 5 — ENTRY DANCER / TENSION CTRL
       id: grp_dancer_entry
       Bindings: dancer_pos_pct, entry_tension_n
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_dancer_entry" filter="url(#drop_shadow)">
    <!-- Dancer arm pivot frame -->
    <rect x="310" y="190" width="80" height="240" rx="4" fill="url(#panel_grad)" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <!-- Fixed rolls top -->
    <rect x="316" y="210" width="68" height="28" rx="14" fill="#374151" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="224" r="11" fill="url(#roll_grad_top)" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="224" r="4" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <!-- Dancer roll (floating) -->
    <rect x="316" y="280" width="68" height="28" rx="14" fill="#1e3a5f" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5">
      <!-- Dancer oscillation -->
      <animate attributeName="y" values="275;285;275" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </rect>
    <circle cx="350" cy="294" r="11" fill="#1e40af" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="1">
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="289;299;289" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <circle cx="350" cy="294" r="4" fill="#1f2937">
      <animate attributeName="cy" values="289;299;289" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <!-- Fixed roll bottom -->
    <rect x="316" y="360" width="68" height="28" rx="14" fill="#374151" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="374" r="11" fill="url(#roll_grad_bot)" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="374" r="4" fill="#1f2937"/>
    <!-- Pneumatic cylinder symbol -->
    <rect x="342" y="316" width="16" height="36" rx="3" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#475569" stroke-width="1"/>
    <rect x="348" y="308" width="4" height="12" fill="#6b7280" rx="1"/>
    <!-- Data display -->
    <rect x="322" y="394" width="56" height="28" rx="2" fill="#0a0e13" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="350" y="405" fill="#64748b" font-size="7" text-anchor="middle">TENSION</text>
    <text id="txt_dancer_tension" x="350" y="417" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="10" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">35.2 N</text>
    <!-- Status LED -->
    <circle id="led_dancer_entry" cx="376" cy="200" r="4.5" fill="#22c55e" filter="url(#glow_green)">
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
    <text x="350" y="428" fill="#475569" font-size="7.5" text-anchor="middle">DANCER-IN</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 6 — ENTRY NIPPING / GUIDE ROLLS
       id: grp_guide_rolls_entry
       Bindings: guide_roll_speed, nip_pressure_in
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_guide_rolls_entry">
    <!-- Roll 1 -->
    <rect x="410" y="262" width="60" height="76" rx="30" fill="#374151" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#drop_shadow)"/>
    <circle cx="440" cy="300" r="26" fill="url(#roll_grad_top)" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="440" cy="300" r="8" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="440" y1="274" x2="440" y2="326" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
    <!-- Roll 2 -->
    <rect x="490" y="262" width="60" height="76" rx="30" fill="#374151" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#drop_shadow)"/>
    <circle cx="520" cy="300" r="26" fill="url(#roll_grad_top)" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="520" cy="300" r="8" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="440" y="354" fill="#475569" font-size="7.5" text-anchor="middle">GR-1</text>
    <text x="520" y="354" fill="#475569" font-size="7.5" text-anchor="middle">GR-2</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 7 — ENTRY LOAD CELL / TENSION METER
       id: grp_loadcell_entry
       Bindings: loadcell_entry_n, tension_setpoint
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_loadcell_entry">
    <rect x="565" y="245" width="72" height="110" rx="4" fill="url(#panel_grad)" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="1.5" filter="url(#drop_shadow)"/>
    <!-- Load cell body -->
    <rect x="578" y="258" width="46" height="40" rx="3" fill="#0f172a" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="586" y="266" width="30" height="8" rx="2" fill="#1e3a5f"/>
    <rect x="586" y="278" width="30" height="4" rx="1" fill="#374151"/>
    <!-- Measurement display -->
    <rect x="575" y="304" width="52" height="38" rx="2" fill="#0a0e13" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="601" y="316" fill="#64748b" font-size="6.5" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="0.5">LOAD CELL</text>
    <text id="txt_lc_entry" x="601" y="329" fill="#fbbf24" font-size="11" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold">35.2N</text>
    <text x="601" y="339" fill="#475569" font-size="7" text-anchor="middle">SP: 35.0 N</text>
    <text x="601" y="363" fill="#475569" font-size="7.5" text-anchor="middle">LC-ENTRY</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
       LAYER 8 — CALENDER MAIN PRESS FRAME
       id: grp_calender_press  ← PRIMARY GROUP
       Sub-groups:
         grp_press_frame, grp_top_roll, grp_bot_roll,
         grp_hydraulic_columns, grp_nip_gap_sensor,
         grp_roll_temp, grp_force_display
  ════════════════════════════════════════════ -->
  <g id="grp_calender_press" filter="url(#drop_shadow)">

    <!-- grp_press_frame: main C-frame structure -->
    <g id="grp_press_frame">
      <!-- Left upright -->
      <rect x="660" y="120" width="50" height="420" rx="6" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- Right upright -->
      <rect x="990" y="120" width="50" height="420" rx="6" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- Top crossbeam -->
      <rect x="660" y="120" width="380" height="55" rx="5" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- Bottom crossbeam -->
      <rect x="660" y="445" width="380" height="55" rx="5" fill="#1f2937" stroke="#374151" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- Tie rods (decorative) -->
      <rect x="692" y="175" width="12" height="270" rx="4" fill="#374151" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="996" y="175" width="12" height="270" rx="4" fill="#374151" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="1"/>
      <!-- PNT Logo plate -->
      <rect x="790" y="128" width="120" height="30" rx="3" fill="#0d1117" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="850" y="148" fill="#38bdf8" font-size="13" text-anchor="middle" font-weight="bold" letter-spacing="3">PNT</text>
    </g>

    <!-- grp_hydraulic_columns: linear actuators top -->
    <g id="grp_hydraulic_columns">
      <!-- Left hydraulic cylinder top -->
      <rect x="712" y="175" width="42" height="62" rx="4" fill="#172554" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="722" y="185" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="#1e40af"/>
      <rect x="726" y="237" width="14" height="26" rx="3" fill="#3b82f6"/>
      <!-- Right hydraulic cylinder top -->
      <rect x="946" y="175" width="42" height="62" rx="4" fill="#172554" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <rect x="956" y="185" width="22" height="8" rx="2" fill="#1e40af"/>
      <rect x="960" y="237" width="14" height="26" rx="3" fill="#3b82f6"/>
      <!-- Pressure lines -->
      <line x1="736" y1="185" x2="736" y2="175" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="754" y1="185" x2="754" y2="175" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
      <line x1="970" y1="185" x2="970" y2="175" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="988" y1="185" x2="988" y2="175" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
    </g>

    <!-- grp_top_roll: upper calender roll -->
    <g id="grp_top_roll">
      <!-- Roll housing (bearing blocks) -->
      <rect x="705" y="253" width="290" height="50" rx="8" fill="#2d3748" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- Roll body -->
      <rect x="720" y="258" width="260" height="40" rx="20" fill="url(#roll_grad_top)" stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2"/>
      <!-- End journals -->
      <rect x="706" y="265" width="20" height="26" rx="4" fill="#4b5563" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
      <rect x="974" y="265" width="20" height="26" rx="4" fill="#4b5563" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="1"/>
      <!-- Roll surface detail lines (chilled roll) -->
      <g opacity="0.25" stroke="#d1d5db" stroke-width="0.5">
        <line x1="740" y1="258" x2="740" y2="298"/>
        <line x1="760" y1="258" x2="760" y2="298"/>
